title: Deep review of apps/dotcom for correctness bugs
reason: Rolls up fixes across tldraw.com sync workers, routes, Zero client handling, authentication, deletion, analytics, and rendering. The two comments say all child PRs merged except #10302 (closed because its route had no caller); a separate MCP render-token URL-length follow-up is tracked in #10967.
assessment: The rollup is primarily about tldraw.com hosted sync/auth and service routes, which Varve does not operate. The MCP render-token URL follow-up has no current Varve endpoint analogue.

title: Deep review of @tldraw/editor for correctness bugs
reason: Rolls up regression-tested fixes across hit testing, geometry, camera, layout, pointer input, mount lifecycle, snapping, persistence, and exports. Its child fixes are separate source/evidence nodes and are not assumed complete from the parent summary.
assessment: The rollup covers Varve-adjacent editor boundaries, and the child reports #10392–#10399 provide concrete local comparison leads. Continue recursively over linked fixes and compare each relevant invariant with Varve instead of importing the rollup as a single conclusion.

title: Sidebar toggle button hit area doesn't match its icon when the sidebar is closed
reason: Reports a mismatch between the visible sidebar icon and its clickable area only when reopening the tldraw.com sidebar. The sole comment attributes the behavior to a browser extension.
assessment: A hosted tldraw.com sidebar report attributed to a browser extension is not evidence of a Varve sidebar defect; no local change is indicated.

varveAssessment.assessment: A hosted tldraw.com sidebar report attributed to a browser extension is not evidence of a Varve sidebar defect; no local change is indicated.

title: Draw tool Shift segment switch threshold scales with zoom
reason: Reports a Shift-assisted draw segment switching threshold measured in canvas units. The author measured 2 CSS px at 25% zoom and 5 CSS px at 100%, and asked for a higher-zoom manual confirmation. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve’s `BaseTool` drag threshold and PenTool handle motion compare CSS-pixel event deltas, consistent with the project’s screen-space threshold rule. Varve PencilTool has no matching Shift/freehand segment-switch mode, so the specific transition cannot be reproduced locally.

title: Canvas ignores pointercancel, so interrupted touch gestures stay stuck
reason: Identifies the absence of `pointercancel` in the upstream canvas input set and the resulting stuck drag/stroke/navigation state. This was a code-review finding from a specified commit and was explicitly not yet browser-confirmed in its source.
assessment: Varve routes `onPointerCancel` through `inputPipeline.ts` to cancel active tool transactions and pointer ownership. A focused Playwright regression now dispatches a pen pointercancel, checks that no provisional shape remains, then confirms a fresh stroke commits. Targeted validation is pending.

title: Pinching during a select tool drag still moves shapes after the fingers lift
reason: Reports selection translate/resize/rotate and brush states ignoring the interrupt when a second touch starts a pinch, then resuming from stale gesture state after fingers lift. The source text says this report was code-derived and not browser-confirmed at the referenced commit.
assessment: Varve’s `inputPolicy.ts` transfers a second touch into navigation and asks the adapter to cancel the owned tool pointer; `SelectTool.onDragCancel` aborts the move transaction and clears previews. Current automated touch coverage checks stroke cancellation and pinch handoff, but not an in-progress selection transform; a dedicated real-interaction regression remains a candidate.

title: Selection action shortcuts run mid-drag instead of waiting for the gesture to end
reason: Reports Delete, lock, grouping, alignment, and other selection shortcuts mutating the active selection mid-gesture, causing stale movement or extra undo entries. The suggested resolution is to defer the action or cancel the gesture first. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve exposes `cancelCanvasInteraction` for rolling back an active canvas gesture, but `useShortcuts.ts` currently dispatches global selection actions without an explicit gesture guard. This is a concrete local regression candidate; reproduce with a real drag and Delete/align shortcut before selecting a safe cancellation boundary.

title: Space+arrow and Alt+arrow also nudge the selected shapes
reason: Reports Space+arrow camera pan or Alt+arrow page navigation also reaching the selection tool and nudging shapes. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve handles Space by arming Hand and returning; Hand arrow panning is handled before generic nudge. `CanvasNudgeController` explicitly finishes and rejects Alt/Ctrl/Meta arrows. No matching double-effect path was found in source.

title: A pen is treated as a coarse pointer
reason: Reports any pen interaction switching a hybrid tablet into coarse touch mode and reducing precision controls. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve automatic tablet layout requires touch capability without a fine pointer; observing a pen contact alone does not select tablet layout. Hit-test touch margins are keyed to actual touch input, while pen events retain pen-specific pressure and precision behavior.

title: Edge-scroll delay and ramp carry over between gestures
reason: Reports the next drag starting at full edge-scroll velocity when the prior drag ended inside the edge band, because the upstream manager retains delay/ramp state. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve’s canvas auto-pan loop has no inter-gesture delay/ramp state: `stopAutoPan` cancels the scheduled frame and resets active state, velocity, and last frame time, and is called on pointer up/cancel. The described carry-over state is absent.
